integrity: The analytic proof is supplied in full, finite exact-rational checks are described without elevating them to an infinite proof, and bibliographic comparison is explicitly limited to inspected literature. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp bound controls a reciprocal-ancestor kernel sum, not the optimal weighted norm of any general sparse averaging operator or Bergman projector. A fixed finite family need not attain the limiting universal constant. An unindexed earlier equivalent remains possible.
title: Sharp reciprocal-ancestor constant for Carleson-packed averaging kernels
